China Defence Minister Addresses Security Forum, Avoids Taiwan Mention

Chinese Defence Minister Dong Jun addressed the Xiangshan Forum, a security conference, warning against militarism and revisionism. His remarks, described as milder by some reports, notably omitted any mention of Taiwan. The speech occurred days after a delegation of Japanese lawmakers visited Beijing. The conference focused on themes of fragility and cooperation in regional security.
